title: How a Godly Man Stays the Same Guy With the Door Closed
caption:
A godly man is the same guy with the door closed. No church version. No private-browser version.

Your public self is easy to manage. Your hidden self is the real read on who you are. What do you do when no one's watching but Him?

The hidden stuff rots a man from the inside. The confessed stuff is the only part that ever heals. Gym version, church version, group-chat version, if they're not the same guy, none of them are real.

Consistency is the actual testimony.

#christianmen #godlymanhood #integrity #biblicalmanhood #discipleship
